name: Starter
about: Read first by the Polio builder. Every path is relative to this file. See BUILDER-CONTRACT.md.

block.why: DexScreener links never point at a specific contract address

rules.about: Design and build rules every code chat follows. The full text is in doc; the checks named enforce them. Missing a style or setting? Add a slot.

list.title: Everything a person sees is a real tagged element
list.rule: Text, icons, dividers, badges, glows and frames are each a real element with its own data-hook. A <canvas> is one part whose drawing takes its colours and sizes from tokens and slots.

list.title: What a script shows later is a state of a part the builder can see
list.rule: Anything a script shows later (example: the 'Connecting to the game server' box later becomes the 'Find a match' button) is built inside a part the builder can see, as a state of that part (a hooked child hidden until shown, or a preview screen), never as a separate element outside it, unless outsideParts lists the file.

list.title: States stay in their frame
list.rule: A part's states belong to the frame around them: they move and resize with it, and each state's box stays inside the frame's box. A state that needs more room makes the frame bigger or becomes its own part.

list.title: Missing a style or setting? Add a slot
list.rule: When code needs a look or setting the builder can't edit yet, make it a token used by the part and list it in rules.slots ({ token, hook, label, kind, why }); the builder shows it in that part's Settings. Never hard-code it, drop it, or draw it some way the builder can't see.

list.title: Styles live in stylesheets, and scripts never write them
list.rule: Every style is a hook-keyed stylesheet rule. Scripts change looks through data attributes or hidden, never el.style, except the positions rule 9 allows.

list.title: Values are tokens
list.rule: Colours, sizes, spacing, radii, timings and any number or text a script uses for how something looks or reads are tokens in tokens.css (and tokens.js), never literals.

list.title: Decorations are elements
list.rule: A ::before, ::after or ::marker rule that draws something (content other than none) becomes a real child element with its own hook.

list.title: The one allowed embed: the DexScreener chart
list.rule: The DexScreener chart embed is the only <iframe> a designed page may show (rules.embeds). The builder shows it as a fixed box it can move and resize, and it never names a specific contract address in the page.

list.title: Scripts may set positions, and only positions
list.rule: A script may set a CSS variable only when rules.scriptPositions.values lists it (the tour box, the loading bar, the duel markers), and stylesheets use those variables only in rules.scriptPositions.properties.

list.title: Hooks stay put
list.rule: No hook the base branch has may disappear or change kind unless design/HOOK-CHANGES.json lists it as deleted in the builder.

list.title: Build from the design record
list.rule: When design/record.json exists, build to it (hooks, parents, states, tokens) and compare a look-only capture with kit:record-diff.

slots.label: Card shadow
slots.why: The shadow under each list card

embeds.name: DexScreener chart
embeds.why: J allows the DexScreener chart embed; the builder shows it as a fixed box it can move and resize.

scriptPositions.why: J allows scripts to set positions (tour box, loading bar, duel markers); everything else about their look stays builder-editable.
